    Class
    Description
    App
    Main application class for the Jammies POS system.
    Cart

    Represents an item within an order's cart.
    CashierController
    Controller for the cashier's main screen (cashier-view.fxml).
    Category
    A menu category, one row of the categories table.
    CategoryRepository
    Repository for accessing and manipulating category data in the database.
    CategoryService
    Service for accessing and manipulating category data.
    DatabaseConfig
    Configuration class for database connection.
    EmployeeController
    Controller for the manager's Employees screen (employee-view.fxml).
    EntryController
    Controller for the cashier's customize screen (entry-view.fxml).
    HourlyReportRow
    One of the rows within an X-report's hourly breakdown.
    Ingredient
    An inventory ingredient, one row of the ingredients table.
    IngredientReportController
    Controller for the manager's ingredient usage report (ingredient-report-view.fxml).
    IngredientRepository
    Repository for accessing and manipulating ingredient data in the database.
    IngredientService
    Service for accessing and manipulating ingredient data.
    IngredientUsageRow
    One ingredient's usage totals for a report period.
    InventoryController
    Controller for the manager's Inventory screen (inventory-view.fxml).
    Item
    A menu item, one row of the items table.
    ItemCategory
    Links a menu item to a category, one row of the item_categories table.
    ItemController
    Controller for the manager's Menu Items screen (item-view.fxml).
    ItemIngredient
    Links a menu item to one ingredient it uses, with how much of that ingredient goes into each item.
    ItemListController
    Controller for the cashier's item list screen (itemList-view.fxml).
    ItemReportController
    Controller for the manager's sales by item report (item-report-view.fxml).
    ItemRepository
    Repository for accessing and manipulating item data in the database.
    ItemSalesRow
    One item's sales totals for a report period.
    ItemService
    Service for accessing and manipulating menu item data.
    Launcher
    Launcher class for the Jammies POS application.
    LoginController
    Controller for the login screen (login-view.fxml), the first screen the app shows.
    ManagerController
    Controller for the manager window (manager-worker-view.fxml).
    Navigator
    Switches the app between screens.
    Order
    A customer order, one row of the orders table.
    OrderController
    Controller for the cashier's order summary list (order-summary.fxml).
    OrderItem
    One line of an order, one row of the order_items table.
    OrderRepository
    Repository for accessing and manipulating order data in the database.
    OrderService
    Service for placing and managing orders.
    PaymentController
    Controller for the cashier's payment screen (payment-view.fxml).
    ReportController
    Controller for the manager's Reports screen (report-view.fxml).
    ReportRepository
    Repository for accessing and generating various reports from the database.
    ReportService
    Service for generating various reports.
    Store
    A store location, one row of the stores table.
    User
    An employee account, one row of the users table.
    UserRepository
    Repository for accessing and manipulating user data in the database.
    UserService
    Service for managing user accounts and authentication.
    XReportController
    Controller for the manager's X-Report (x-report-view.fxml).
    XReportData
    The data for a single day's X-Report.
